page.notes: Printed "4" at the bottom right, read as a page or signature mark; uncertain which. Doubtful readings: "uistima" (s/long s and ligature, marked [?]); "ire ubet" split across the line end, the printed word is unclear (marked [?]). Several entries have their page references split from the text or wrapped onto a second line; the number placed on the line where it is printed beside the entry. Printing errors left as printed, e.g. "Sophisticen", "lebus", "Ierichuntina", "infirmis tantum ... concedum", "conuenientes", "Infomnis" for Insomnia. The "32.b" and "34" on the "infirmi non intelligunt" entry are ambiguous in position.
